unit.why: The division holds an anecdote about the Maggid of Mezeritch questioning the Maggid of Zlotchov about his grandson, then an editorial note with a second short anecdote about a young man after the Megillah reading, which turns into a teaching on 'frum'.
unit.boundary_note: the second anecdote sits inside an editor's parenthetical note (א"ה)

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מפיו הק׳ כ״פ שסיפר כי
stories.end_quote: ואמר כי אין אתה מבין כלל
stories.summary_en: The tsaddik often told that, as a small boy, his grandfather the Maggid of Mezeritch asked the Maggid of Zlotchov whether he knew the boy; when the Zlotchover called him very 'frum', the Maggid grew angry and said he understood nothing.

tags.why: framed as a tale the tsaddik told many times

quotes: המכיר כבודו את נכדי שלי״ט הלזה
היה המגיד מזאלטשוב בעל אורח לחיים
tags.why: the Maggid of Zlotchov appears, though as a tsaddik rather than in the separate role of preacher
the Maggid is angry at the Zlotchover's judgment

quotes: היה המגיד מזאלטשוב בעל אורח לחיים אצל
tags.why: the Zlotchover is visiting the Maggid
the point is the boy's true, not merely 'frum', piety

stories.start_quote: ופ״א שמעתי כי אחר קריאת המגילה
stories.summary_en: After the rebbe read the Megillah himself, a young hasid who had followed along feared he had missed a word; the rebbe called this 'frum' and taught that the essence is cleaving to God's will in the mitzvah, not merely fulfilling the obligation.

quotes: אחר קריאת המגילה שהיה הוא ז"ל קורא בעצמו
ולכן הוא ירא אולי לא יצאתי י"ח
tags.why: concern about fulfilling the obligation of the mitzvah

quotes: כי ירא אנכי אולי לא שמעתי היטב
tags.why: the young man's fear that he did not fulfil the mitzvah

quotes: והאדם צריך לדבק כ״ב בהרצון ה׳
tags.why: teaching on cleaving to the divine will

quotes: אבל העיקר הכונה הוא לקיים רצון ה'
tags.why: the tsaddik's teaching with a verse
the anecdote is mostly a frame for a teaching on 'frum'

quotes: ועמד אצלו אברך חסיד וי״ש אחד
tags.why: the rebbe corrects a hasid's attitude
